summary: Frontend-only targeted verification for iteration_117 (rail nav audit + retired row + admin overview footer + iteration_116 MEDIUM findings-row interaction fix + REG5 overlay round-trip). RESULTS: 41/42 rail rows PASS. Retired row PASS. Admin overview footer 3/3 PASS. Findings row interaction fix PASS on all reachable controls (a/b/d/e). REG5 overlay round-trip end-to-end PASS with 10 healthy /intelligence/overlays calls (8 GET 200 + 1 PUT 200 save + 1 DELETE 200 revert). ONE REAL DEFECT FOUND that violates the shell-regression rule declared in this iteration's request: clicking Assets → Vulnerability Exposure (xdr-nav-exposure → /xdr/exposure) throws a React error inside XdrExposurePage that unmounts XdrShell — xdr-sidebar and xdr-tenant-pill both go to visible=false and the page renders a black screen with body innerText length 0. ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Assets → Vulnerability Exposure (xdr-nav-exposure) crashes the page: React error boundary triggers at XdrExposurePage.jsx:32, XdrShell is torn down, xdr-sidebar and xdr-tenant-pill become invisible, body renders empty (innerText length 0). This is a direct violation of the shell-regression rule stated in this iteration's request ('rail (xdr-sidebar) and tenant pill (xdr-tenant-pill) must stay mounted') and is not on the intentional NOT_IMPLEMENTED list (identity/network/attack-paths/critical) — /xdr/exposure is a real, active surface. Reproducible: sign in → expand Assets rail → click Vulnerability Exposure. Visible in the browser console as 'The above error occurred in the <div> component: at XdrExposurePage ...'. Directly navigating to /xdr/exposure crashes the same way.

None of the 6 findings on /xdr/incidents/inc_c312e0180ec742778b6b?tab=activity expose an inv-findings-ent-<fid> or inv-findings-mitre-<fid> chip in the DOM (0 results for either selector across the whole findings-table), even though the ENTITIES column displays entity strings (rule:EDR-LNX-002, process:bash, commandline:*, lolbin:Bash.exe, incident:inc_...). The iteration_117 spec requires those chips to open the pane on their respective tabs while staying on Activity — that acceptance path is unreachable because the chip elements themselves are not being rendered. Requirements (a) row body click, (b) inv-findings-ev-<fid>, (d) inv-findings-inspect-<fid>, (e) inv-findings-pivot-<fid> are all present and working correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rail audit was executed row-by-row with >=3s pacing (per CF 429 warning). All 42 rail rows land on the expected path and mark themselves active EXCEPT xdr-nav-exposure which crashes XdrShell — retest that route first after fix. The iter_116 findings-row fix is real: on ?tab=activity the row body/ev-chip/inspect/pivot all behave as spec'd (only pivot navigates, and it's disabled when no evidence ref). REG5 overlay end-to-end works and all overlay HTTPs are 200. The two open items after this run are (1) HIGH: /xdr/exposure shell unmount; (2) MEDIUM: entity+MITRE chips missing from FindingsTab. Cloudflare 429s occasionally hit rapid navigation — a single retry with a fresh goto and a scroll_into_view_if_needed cleared them for the View IOC Intelligence link on this run.
rca of the issue: XdrExposurePage /xdr/exposure crash: React error boundary trace names the child of XdrShell as XdrExposurePage (XdrExposurePage.jsx:32:31). The page reads /api/xdr/cve/status + /cves + /assets + /software + /exposures; if any of those return a shape other than the array/object the render code destructures, the render throws and — because XdrShell is rendered inside the page rather than around it via a route layout — the whole rail unmounts. Mitigation: (a) wrap the page body in an ErrorBoundary, (b) initialize the six pieces of state with safe defaults (arrays/null) and null-guard every access in the render, (c) surface the underlying API error to the analyst honestly ('NOT AVAILABLE') rather than throwing. FindingsTab ent/MITRE chips missing: the chip elements simply are not emitted for any finding — a code change to render <button data-testid={`inv-findings-ent-${fid}`}> and <button data-testid={`inv-findings-mitre-${fid}`}> next to the existing Evidence/Inspect/Pivot controls will cover iteration_117 (c).
